messages:
maya: Morning — quick scheduling ask. Can we move our dawn wave (tomorrow) from 07:00 PT to 08:30 PT? Infra's doing a DB migration that overlaps the earlier slot. Need someone to take 08:30 and own smoke + rollback readiness. Ping owners please. :pray:

arjun: Is the change set only on inference-proxy + model-store? Any heavy schema work?

maya: Just inference-proxy + routing rules for dedicated pools. No schema change. Services: inference-proxy, router, metrics-agent, canary model v2. Expected deploy time ~20m.

sam: I can take 08:30. I'll be smoke owner. Can you share quick smoke checklist and rollback command?

maya: thanks! basic checklist:
```
- deploy inference-proxy (canary -> 5%)
- run smoke script: ./scripts/smoke.sh --env=stg --targets=proxy,router
- run perf check: curl -s -XPOST https://perf.internal/run -d '{"suite":"smoke"}'
- validate latency < 120ms p50 and no error spikes
- if fail: rollback: kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-proxy
```

lucy: @sam noted. How long of a quiet window do you need after deploy to call it healthy?

sam: 15m looking at logs/metrics + 5m rush check for throttling. So ~20m total.

ops-bot: Calendar update: moved 'dawn-wave' slot from 07:00 to 08:30 PT. Attendees: sam, maya, arjun. (automated)

arjun: I'll be on standby for rollback if needed, reachable on phone. Also please tag me in the canary diffs.

maya: added canary diff link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/compare/feat/canary-routes

lucy: cool. Sam — can you add a quick smoke run script entry to runbook after the deploy? we want repeatability.

sam: will do, adding runbook snippet now.

sam: snippet added to runbook: https://runbooks.internal/runbook/infra/dawn-wave-smoke

maya: great. final ask: if any regressions, escalate to @arjun and abort the wave. Otherwise I'll mark done in the release board.

sam: got it. I'll post a final `done` in this thread after smoke passes. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks team — moving to final schedule. :rocket:
